resources.string: Allow location access first — the system will not offer “All the time” before that.
This permission is required to record a track
Runs, rides, walks and drives — with a precise GPS track.
Korno filters out signal spikes and “teleports”, and detects stops so your average speed stays honest.
Everything is computed on your device. Nothing leaves your phone until you choose to share or sync.
Korno needs location access to record your routes. Here is what each permission is for.
Korno uses GPS to record your route during an activity. Without this permission recording is not possible.
Allow location access “All the time” so recording continues even when the screen is off or the app is in the background.
Lets Korno detect the activity type automatically in the future — walking, running or cycling.
While recording, Korno shows a notification with the current track status and playback controls.
